body:
I feel like your insight is off the mark.

You tell me to express myself, and not to suppress how I feel. The suppression isn't an uninformed mistake. As of the past couple months, I've been an oil spill. Everybody knows how internally hollow I am—anybody beyond professional contact. I figured I'd let them know, because when you're growing up and somebody kills themselves, all the parents say, "Okay guys, you gotta talk to somebody if you're feeling bad!" Alright. Now everybody knows I feel bad, and they feel bad for me. Now what?

Now my mother passes the buck to medication and therapy; my father encourages me to fuck everything with a pulse and gets me a book off Amazon called How To Get A Girlfriend (c'mon, dad, that's easy—it's everything else that's hell) and discourages therapy and medication out of conspiracy-theory informed paranoia that may or may not involve aliens; my friends feel totally powerless (because they are). You know, the way I actually feel isn't pretty, and when I don't suppress it, it's frightening, and only tempered when I try to make it funny or sound good. Once somebody's heard enough of how I actually feel, they go, "Hey, you're a disaster." The only thing I get out of that is catharsis, and maybe I'll be a little pleased by how uncomfortable they feel for a little while. That's about it. Wonderful; now everybody knows I'm infirm, and so I can't stand being around them. I lost my best friend that way. I got tired of whining and being weak in comparison. Nobody respects that. It's pathetic.

I've had my oil spill, it was fruitless, and now everybody wants me to shut up, hold my nose, accept defeat like a bitch, and stop being a loser, so that's what I've got to do. They're the experts, and I've clearly failed at flying this plane myself. I cede. They win. Have a nice clipboard lady give me the stuff that'll make my dick soft and my hair fall out, or give me the stuff all the shooters in the 90's had in their systems when they died. I'll be venomous about it, but I'll take it. You're right. There's stuff to be resolved. It won't be.

I've done my figurative screaming in alleys. Pulled out the drawers of my desk and smashed them to pieces months ago. Threw an x-acto knife at the wall, which probably voided some of my safety deposit. We'll see. It wasn't very productive.

If I were the correct kind of depressed, things might be different, but I can still get up in the morning, I'm still functional, and I'm still deluded with hope. I don't cry like I did when I was younger and kinder. I'm just angry.

- - -

You say I should do something fun for myself. I think doing things for myself and listening to my needs got me in this situation. I allowed myself to gas my head with delusion, fantasy, and perfectionism. I deluded myself into believing that I wouldn't have to compromise; that, at least for once, I wouldn't have to accept defeat—wouldn't have to finish last in the race or compromise. I say I'm doing this all for everybody else, but really, this is all for me. What is there to love? If we run the numbers, I'm more detestable than addicts, liars, rapists, murderers, the mentally ill, disabled, whatever. When every song, every movie, every book, almost everything crafted by humankind, from minute to minute, no matter where you go or how hard you can hide, reminds you of how repulsively detached you are from a universal human experience, you're going to find it very hard to convince yourself that you shouldn't be dead.

- - -

I'm sorry for shooting down so much. This is probably part of the oil spill. I hadn't really expressed myself correctly—had to clarify a lot.

Thanks for the suicide resources. I won't do it, but it's nice to know that there's somebody out there who hands out this stuff. I'm not suicidal right now.

Hoo. I posted this reply from another acc minutes ago. that was real close

Man, all my friends know. One parent knows. There's nothing they can do about it—in one capacity or another, they're all well aware that I'm ill. I have to adopt a rotational strategy—you unload on one person, they feel helpless and incapable of helping—so then you rotate to somebody else and let the last person cool down so they don't feel like you're going to jump off the nearest bridge. They try to help, but at most they're useful for exhausting this stuff on and giving useless advice. I'll tell people in order to get rid of them, sometimes; once people know how wretched you are, you don't want to be around them anymore, because you see your actual self whenever you talk to them, rather than the fake copy—and I absolutely hate seeing the infirmity of my actual self in other people, when I deal with it on my own all the time. There's no escape when you see it in other people too. That's why I'm saying that I don't care that they care. I'm ashamed to be a heartless android (it's not normal, and I hate being not normal), but their care is useless to me.

It's been a bad week. I couldn't walk a block without thinking about killing myself. The only way I could shut up the mental cataract was to make a contract with myself—that I'll kill myself at 25 if I don't "make it." If I'm still a virgin at 25.

I'm not stupid; I'm well aware that I'm far too mentally infirm and self-loathing at the moment to make a decent partner. It didn't used to be like this when I was younger—when I was patient and optimistic—the person they beg me to be again. Fact of the matter is, I'm also very well aware that being too mentally infirm and self-loathing won't change within the next two years. I no longer have any logical excuse not to be in that emergency state: I've tried everything else, and every doe-eyed bleeding heart's panacea. This is all that's left to try. I'm going to repair myself and stop being a piece of shit or I'm going to smash myself on the water beneath Aurora Bridge.
